title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.11341v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form.   We introduce Apodex Discovery, a framework for building and evaluating discoverative AI through the heavy-duty solver, a system comprising a foundation model, harness, tools, and control policies that pursues extended, stateful, verifiable investigations. It has three core components. First, a problem-scouting process surveyed 561 industries across 16 sectors, assembled 423 high-value real-world problems, and selected 20 for the initial release. translated_title: Apodex发现：用于评估和构建探索性人工智能的现实基准与环境
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11341v1 公告类型：新 摘要：阿波罗登月并非仅仅因为其工程师能解决复杂方程而成功。它通过将遥远的目标转化为明确目标、模拟、验证和反复修正的任务架构而实现。人工智能现在面临类似的转变：一旦问题、工具和成功标准被明确，前沿模型就能解决困难任务，然而具有重大影响的现实世界挑战很少以可执行或可验证的形式出现。我们引入了Apodex发现框架，用于通过重型求解器构建和评估探索性人工智能，该系统由基础模型、工具、控制策略组成，追求扩展的、有状态的、可验证的调查。它有三个核心组成部分。首先，一个问题侦察过程调查了16个行业的561个行业，整理了423个高价值现实世界问题，并选出20个用于初始发布。其次，一个通用环境-任务...
tldr: 本文提出了Apodex发现框架，通过重型求解器系统（包含基础模型、工具和控制策略）构建和评估探索性人工智能，其核心创新在于系统化的问题侦察流程，从广泛行业调查中筛选高价值现实问题，以支持可验证的长期调查任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Apodex Discovery framework for building and evaluating discoverative AI via a heavy-duty solver system, with its key innovation being a systematic problem-scouting process that selects high-value real-world problems from broad industry surveys to support verifiable long-horizon investigations.
